public_rationale: This is a sweeping summary, not a testable claim. 'Every bad sign' covers a loose mix of items: competition, pricing, staff departures, open-source models, Sora, costs, reliability and profit. Most have no stated measure of 'worse', and some could be judged better or worse depending on the measure chosen. 'People are finally noticing' gives no threshold for public attention. Several of the underlying items, such as the lack of profit and unsolved hallucination, are assessed as separate claims.
limitations: Parts of the summary could be checked one by one, but no single plain reading covers 'every' sign.
